metadata.description: {\rtf1 DeHumanizer Pro\par Intentional dynamics shaping for modern drum programming.\par \par Two independent engines:\par \par VELOCITY ENGINE — Drawable curve canvas for shaping velocity across a phrase. Role-aware targeting, live preview, drift tension, phrase reset logic, and full persistence.\par \par TIMING ENGINE — Per-role lean (rush/drag) and scatter with biased bell-curve distribution. Drawable per-role scatter curves for phrase-position-aware timing variance. Beat-aware tightening keeps downbeats locked. Tempo-aware PPQ math and BPM-aware tooltips.\par \par Requires ReaImGui.}

metadata.description:
Generates heavy-music drum MIDI patterns in REAPER. Comes with 43 grooves across 12 genre categories ready to go. Covers blast beats, djent, thall, death metal, black metal, grindcore, metalcore, doom, sludge, progressive metal, thrash, and breakdowns. Includes 4 MIDI map presets with an in-script editor, power hand control, configurable time signatures (4/4, 3/4, 7/8, 5/4), humanize/push-pull timing, and auto tom fills.
Requirements: REAPER 6.0+, ReaImGui 0.8+

version.author: Dead Pixel Design
version.changelog: Drummer-physics humanization pass. No two consecutive hits on a pitch share a velocity. Cymbals struck together with a kick, snare, or tom land about 12% harder. Closed hi-hats play softer than open. Kicks cap at 114: punchy, never maxed. Weak left foot now applies only on true double-kick runs instead of every even grid step. Turnaround fill rebuilt as a real roll: flam start, toms descending with velocity ramping up, kicks kept underneath, and a kick under the landing crash.

version.author: Dead Pixel Design
version.changelog: Cymbal chokes. New CHINA_CHOKE, CRASH_CHOKE, and SPLASH_CHOKE map slots play the kit's hit-and-grab articulation; pattern chars C, c, and s put them on the crash lane. Chokes are optional per map: a kit without choke notes plays the open cymbal instead of dropping the hit. Ultimate Heavy Drums (MDL Tone) preset ships with its real choke notes. Capture round-trips choke notes.

metadata.description:
Splits video items into separate video and audio tracks in one click.
Select one or more video items on the timeline, run the action, and a dedicated audio track appears directly below — synced, named, and ready to edit. The original video item's audio output is silenced so nothing double-plays.
Supported formats: MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WMV, M4V, WebM, FLV, MTS, TS
Fully undoable. No dependencies required.

metadata.description:
The REAPER side of Reaper Daemon, the free, open source MCP server that lets an AI agent (Claude or any MCP client) drive REAPER.
Agents drop JSON command files into an inbox folder; this script (running as a background deferred action inside REAPER) executes them and writes JSON results to an outbox. No network, no server. Just atomic file writes.
Reads every plugin and parameter, sets FX values, writes automation, inserts MIDI, and measures a mix move before and after. Mutating commands are wrapped in REAPER undo blocks.
ReaPack installs the bridge script and its bundled skills. For the MCP server and the Python CLI, clone https://github.com/wretcher207/reaper-daemon. The bridge does not auto-start: run it once from the Action List, or let the repo's setup/install.py add it to REAPER's startup. No dependencies required.

ReaPack installs only the bridge script and its json.lua. For the Python CLI, the MCP server, and the drum engine, clone https://github.com/wretcher207/reaper-daemon. version.author: Dead Pixel Design
version.changelog: Catches this package up from 3.13.0 to the Reaper Daemon 3.20.0 release. Highlights since 3.13.0: save live FX chains and capture a mix recipe with track settings, routing, automation and plugin state, then compare it with the current session or rebuild it without media in a separate project tab (3.20.0). Faster command polling, read-only mix snapshots and validated batches, with the arrangement-midi and drum-humanize skills now bundled (3.19.0). Separate write gates, so letting an agent measure a mix no longer lets it overwrite your project file (3.18.0). Offline media is visible, warned about, and fixable (3.17.0). ReaPack installs the bridge, json.lua and the bundled skills. The MCP server, CLI, recipe commands and engines require a clone of https://github.com/wretcher207/reaper-daemon.

metadata.description:
Drops incoming Note-On strikes below a velocity threshold. Everything else passes through untouched: note-offs, zero-velocity note-ons, CC, pitch bend, aftertouch, program change, and the original MIDI channel.
Built for MIDI guitar controllers (Yamaha and similar) that send a fixed low-velocity signal when fret/string buttons are pressed. Set the threshold one above that value and the unwanted notes vanish.
Includes a Learn button: turn it on, play only the notes you want to discard, turn it off. The threshold auto-sets to one above the loudest velocity you played.
